intended_object: The canonical natural transformation from the pointwise left-coset presheaf X ↦ G(X)/i(H(X)) to the represented presheaf Hom(-, Q). It is induced by a morphism q : G ⟶ Q that is invariant under the right action of H, and sends [x] to x ≫ q. Inferred from the docstring, the name and the module documentation.
explanation: The body is NatTrans.cosetLift applied to yoneda.map q, i.e. the factorisation of x ↦ x ≫ q through G(X) ⧸ range(i_X), taken with respect to QuotientGroup.leftRel (left cosets x·i(H)). Well-definedness is proved in yonedaCosetMap_rel: if y = x * (a ≫ i), then x ≫ q = y ≫ q, using the commutativity of the square (h.w) for the right action (g, h) ↦ g·i(h). Naturality comes from yoneda.map q. So the definition is exactly the induced map G/H → Q on functors of points. Only commutativity of the square is needed for the construction; requiring IsPullback is stronger than necessary but harmless, is stated in the docstring, and the library uses it right after to prove pointwise injectivity. The setting is fully general: any cartesian monoidal category, arbitrary group objects, no normality assumption, and no group structure needed on Q. I don't know of a Mathlib declaration for this specific map.
